headline: FCC fines 8 firms $25k each for dodging DJI foreign drone ban
summary: FCC cracks down on companies suspected of skirting drone ban
details: The FCC is fining eight companies $25,000 each for potentially dodging the US foreign drone ban. These companies, including Cogito Tech and Xtra Technology, are suspected of marketing radio equipment from banned Chinese drone companies.

caption:
FCC fines 8 firms for dodging drone ban

The FCC is fining eight companies $25,000 each for potentially dodging the US foreign drone ban. These companies, including Cogito Tech and Xtra Technology, are suspected of marketing radio equipment from banned Chinese drone companies.

The FCC added all foreign drone companies to its Covered List on December 22nd, blocking authorizations due to national security risks. The companies have 10 days to respond to the FCC's questions.

The FCC is also investigating testing labs that helped get these products through the certification process, including SGS-CTST Standards Technical Services Co, which is owned by a Chinese company.
